messages.subject: Suggestion on dynamic UI
parts:
Hi shiny users,


I am seeking any suggestion on how to create a dynamic UI where the number of sliders or radioButtons based on the user input.

For example, in the app, the user can type a number, e.g. 3, in a numeric input box, and then 3 sliders or radioButtons will show up in the UI.

Any suggestion or comment on this? Much appreciated.

Thanks.
Jia

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Suggestion on dynamic UI
parts:
You can use uiOutput/renderUI, and the renderUI would have something like:

lapply(1:input$count, function(i) {
  sliderInput(paste0("slider_", i), ...)
})
